scope: Editable Human starting looks for explicit selection; no automatic NPC or Randomize adoption.

authoring_notes.geometry: Consensus of two independent textured Meshy 6-lite reconstructions per character, fitted against the current 23-control RL heads. Only mutually measured controls agreeing within 0.3 are retained.
authoring_notes.colours: Skin and hair use the median reference measurements converted through the client calibration. Iris pigments are authored from the concepts because the 3D references do not resolve them reliably.
authoring_notes.grooming: Cornrows, rounded Afro, receding sweep with attached short beard, curly twin buns, shoulder waves and Bram's approved attached full beard. Existing PC/2 fallbacks and Mira/Rowan rules are preserved.
authoring_notes.garments: Indigo shirt and neutral brown pants/boots, with client garment limits applied.
authoring_notes.quality: Selected reference fits are ok or review, with disputed controls retained as review notes.
authoring_notes.compatibility: Select the newest supported appearance source. PC/3 omits aging and tied-hair height; PC/2 retains its palette and supported face/hair fields.
authoring_notes.additional_humans: New concept-guided editable drafts use paired face references where qualified and explicitly authored controls otherwise. Their likeness and temporary hairstyle approximations await review.
